Name: Pelican Town Hustle (Stardew x Schedule I)
Author: nickbuck11
Description:
[center][size=6][b]PELICAN TOWN HUSTLE[/b][/size]
[size=4]Stardew Valley x Schedule I[/size][/center]

Pelican Town has a new side business, and you're the one running it. Grow products on your farm, cook them at a Chemistry Station, mix in effects, and sell to the villagers. Some of them get hooked. Some of them call you at 6 AM. And if you're careless, the new Pelican Town police will be waiting.

[size=5][b]Grow[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Gus sells seeds out of the Saloon: OG Kush, Sour Diesel, Green Crack, Granddaddy Purple, Coca, Pseudo, and Acid.[/*]
[*]Weed grows spring to fall in 6 days. Coca grows summer/fall in 8 days and regrows every 3.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Cook & Mix[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Chemistry Station[/b]: 3 Coca Leaf + 1 Acid = Cocaine. 2 Pseudo + 1 Acid = 2 Meth.[/*]
[*][b]Mixing Station[/b]: load a stack, add an ingredient, and every unit gets an effect: Coffee (Energizing), Green Tea (Calming), Pizza (Munchies), Cave Carrot (Bright-Eyed), Battery Pack (Electrifying), Pufferfish (Zombifying). Mixed products sell for more, and villagers who crave that effect pay extra.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Deal[/b][/size]
Hold the product and right-click a villager instead of gifting. They tell you how much they want. Then:
[list]
[*][b]Sell[/b] at their price. Favorites pay 1.5x, plus 3% per heart.[/*]
[*][b]Push[/b] for 30% more. Fail, and the deal is off, and they like you a little less.[/*]
[*][b]Walk away[/b].[/*]
[/list]Every villager has a favorite and a craving. Lewis will fine you. Harvey confiscates. The kids won't buy.

[size=5][b]Addiction & Phone Calls[/b][/size]
Every deal hooks your customer a little more: Casual, Regular, Hooked, Fiend. Hooked customers buy more, pay more, and are easier to push. Skip them, and they call you in the morning. Promise to come and break it, and they'll remember. Press [b]K[/b] for your Customer List.

[size=5][b]Heat & Police[/b][/size]
Every deal raises your heat, more in daylight, in the Saloon, or in front of witnesses. Get hot enough and officers patrol town. If one spots you: [b]comply, bribe, or run[/b]. Get caught carrying, and you're arrested, your product is confiscated, and you spend a few hours in the new [b]Pelican Town Jail[/b] behind JojaMart. Your farm is always safe.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0+[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
Unzip into [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] so you have both [b]PelicanTownHustle[/b] and [b]PelicanTownHustleDeals[/b], then launch through SMAPI. The full guide (prices, favorites, cravings, console commands) is in README.txt.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Edits the Town map (police station behind JojaMart) and adds new items, crops, machines, and an NPC. Map mods that change that part of town may conflict. Not tested with Stardew Valley Expanded. Single-player tested.

[size=5][b]Made live on stream[/b][/size]
I built this mod live. Bugs and ideas are welcome in the comments.
